description: List saved contacts (your address book). Returns each contact's name, phone number, email, and ID. Optionally filter with a search term that matches name or phone number.

limit.description: How many contacts to return in one page.

offset.description: How many contacts to skip before this page, for paging.

search.description: Match contacts by name or phone number.

name: list_contacts

id.description: The contact's unique ID (use as contact_id).

notes.description: Free-text notes about the contact, or null.

updatedAt.description: When the contact was last updated (ISO 8601).

hasMore.description: Whether more results exist beyond this page.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: List Contacts
